gloss: to position; to situate; to place in context

definitions.gloss: to position; to situate; to place in context; to define the role of
definitions.explanation: To assign a particular position, role, or significance to something within a larger framework. Often used in academic, business, and policy discussions to describe how something is categorized or valued.

examples.japanese: この{政策|せいさく}を{最重要課題|さいじゅうようかだい}と{位置|いち}づける。
examples.english: To position this policy as the most important issue.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は{環境問題|かんきょうもんだい}を{国際協力|こくさいきょうりょく}の{柱|はしら}と{位置|いち}づけている。
examples.english: Japan positions environmental issues as a pillar of international cooperation.

examples.japanese: この{作品|さくひん}を{文学史|ぶんがくし}の{中|なか}でどのように{位置|いち}づけるかについて、{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}の{間|あいだ}で{議論|ぎろん}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: Debate continues among scholars about how to situate this work within literary history.

notes:
USAGE:
{位置|いち}づける is a transitive ichidan verb. It is commonly used in the pattern AをBと{位置|いち}づける (to position A as B).

ASPECT (ている):
{位置|いち}づけている indicates an ongoing stance or characterization.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]を[role]と{位置|いち}づける (to position something as a role)
- [thing]を[context]の{中|なか}で{位置|いち}づける (to situate something within a context)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重要|じゅうよう}と{位置|いち}づける (to position as important)
- {中心|ちゅうしん}に{位置|いち}づける (to position at the center)
- {位置|いち}づけが{難|むずか}しい (difficult to categorize)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{位置|いち}づける focuses on assigning significance within a framework. {分類|ぶんるい}する means to classify or categorize and is more about sorting into groups.
